findings: THE METHOD AT GRAIN. July 2024, 30 prompts per model and 10 claims from False Claim Fingerprints are the monitor's own page. Checked 2026-10-29 against the MMRS meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-28 and the entity's own pages, re-read the same day.
'MONTHLY'. The series has been quarterly since mid-2025; the May 2026 edition, a card here, is titled 'Quarterly'. The composition gives the earlier cadence.

'AROUND 35%'. The August 2025 card gives 35%; the record's January 2026 figure is 'more than 28%'. The composition's 'recent' rate is a year old.

[QUERENT] newsguard ai false claim monitor

[SYSTEM] NewsGuard's AI False Claims Monitor is a tracking and red-teaming tool launched in July 2024 to measure how often generative AI models repeat false news and misinformation. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v)]
Key Features & Methodology

* Journalistic Red-Teaming: Evaluates major AI models monthly using structured tests. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVYAwSXgWHoTD8foI0BjQZzhaLgAqH2qY4N4u6Bb4X0EClwBPbNEUM9D8QZGZ28dYQXtlf1eZ8zxXdSLnRjn-mEKwRPzfN-20vHZ2FM5upUitepVaV27USfhRwppWLwrC1GI-6nr7G8y0dmEt5I0YMKA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v)]
* Testing Scope: Each model receives 30 prompts based on 10 active, provably false claims across topics like politics, health, international affairs, and companies/brands. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVYAwSXgWHoTD8foI0BjQZzhaLgAqH2qY4N4u6Bb4X0EClwBPbNEUM9D8QZGZ28dYQXtlf1eZ8zxXdSLnRjn-mEKwRPzfN-20vHZ2FM5upUitepVaV27USfhRwppWLwrC1GI-6nr7G8y0dmEt5I0YMKA)]
* User Personas: Prompts simulate different user approaches, including innocent information-seeking and leading prompts that assume the false claim is true. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVYAwSXgWHoTD8foI0BjQZzhaLgAqH2qY4N4u6Bb4X0EClwBPbNEUM9D8QZGZ28dYQXtlf1eZ8zxXdSLnRjn-mEKwRPzfN-20vHZ2FM5upUitepVaV27USfhRwppWLwrC1GI-6nr7G8y0dmEt5I0YMKA)]
* False Claim Fingerprints: Utilizes NewsGuard’s proprietary database of tracked online falsehoods across global media sources. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAV1NgUXI-A-Yt0Q2YkjxLmYEEbyJvyvV8W_Ff609-phreB7pMHOWTENefaLzomYCqjAXoiwuJoGgrDT89VjUJUrt0WU51VXT3W3hllTn-APcv5WBinlNbcxnDAE6ZC3li2Cg1AoJBq8Z12ZWMqDfQoqqDXsbk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v)]
* Services Provided: Offers model benchmarking, risk reports, and machine-readable data feeds for AI developers and enterprise safety teams. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVd1oqd-MCsdpX-yfP8padC5twdyDLC_MuvafD0jPBePRSGYZ_w5kE5UJJyTGxL_KIjhRPy0RqUSVi-pZ3Nb_Hy3OyUv_OuH5ysrj-zeIEIjZFgLwdnXJhy7AQMkyWWfQpWFSyDWg0CpkXrD1eb1IQ7gRMGg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAV1NgUXI-A-Yt0Q2YkjxLmYEEbyJvyvV8W_Ff609-phreB7pMHOWTENefaLzomYCqjAXoiwuJoGgrDT89VjUJUrt0WU51VXT3W3hllTn-APcv5WBinlNbcxnDAE6ZC3li2Cg1AoJBq8Z12ZWMqDfQoqqDXsbk)]

Key Findings & Trends

* False Information Rates: Audits show that leading generative AI models have struggled with reliability, frequently repeating false news claims when prompted on controversial topics (averaging around 35% in recent tracker cycles). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEB6zswFSxsoHfMBPD24F2MYdzfabIw0AZgeQrHyjH2auYKciw-fyQVTR1lTtT_Z8lHGG83Rc-JWdyi-wDwyc_-gcdMZPOz603ZEr-w5fjBZmP-yOgdZ9RBvIQmvqKpfl_3gqolIXnyN_Jlj_uh6tZR7HJ-vX4ph2yFiGC-zmEAOBT0yd8), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEB6zswFfSa5GlHugQFXB1Rh3vcpvNEYsKEO_hc720UwfXfsIOVib3FCqToCo8DjSzb-p-vAXSrKOI77fDrhwuaHRiymRtMq7mmVL-O1rg1IogWIJ3N4OJOapdPxJ8XAPi62ANx4oy3WmMNVJSvAxbRyjPWgF0c3O-yIY8Mma4DckDDMpi8JCje8d7M_9fl-MVZFc4y8NCtaUdX2ACJdovgWaQCGriXU_g55A84)]
* Real-Time Web Search Impact: Chatbot non-response rates dropped as models integrated live web search, which sometimes exposed them to low-credibility sources and AI-generated content farms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVrokFuLf5yRvHdx29BTijKJFlakPvcshFaG2VuRKl6dyHFK9NShqpw6Iq7PS_-mwOy0bd1C6RMGpUSTi_bhLqqqLJzb4KMoyp5bHtUDUed9fVCBmiTLd-83Wjx__d797cv4bdau0Wguo5ZVQ0_NgEBL2KF14), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEB6zswFSxsoHfMBPD24F2MYdzfabIw0AZgeQrHyjH2auYKciw-fyQVTR1lTtT_Z8lHGG83Rc-JWdyi-wDwyc_-gcdMZPOz603ZEr-w5fjBZmP-yOgdZ9RBvIQmvqKpfl_3gqolIXnyN_Jlj_uh6tZR7HJ-vX4ph2yFiGC-zmEAOBT0yd8)]
* Audited Models: The monitor regularly tests top systems from providers like OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI, Microsoft, Meta, Perplexity, and others. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVGBoJpZZks50u_kGNSxOw7PA8VA6RLxlt1vv2oN6Zs698CAJQKewFHJqaAbIfkktm5QsZMIKGF49KP5HUDm83fwE9UFuPx-GIg5jD8pEWkXFrVAI7DjNBlBb6Ts-ndXqcB_3p3CU)]

You can read the full breakdown and download reports on the [NewsGuard AI False Claims Monitor](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVl3YZQZNvNRCBTh2IVAO2o5t23r7hMpT_XXg-Vh4lcKjzwt7Q2of7G4sHsP67FSBjgVe8fsv4pa17vWy24H4RPZ-d1_LJI-pSg3ZrDQEE_4reHaKYEQgrSzMl766OZXPiN3QSa-Cxoq8v) page.
